title.zh: 马斯克给Grok Bot接Claude Opus 5.5：以后谁好用就用谁
title.en: 马斯克给Grok Bot接Claude Opus 5.5：以后谁好用就用谁

current_state.zh: Musk announced that SpaceXAI's always-on Grok Bot agent will route tasks to whichever backend model or API performs best, explicitly naming Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney and Suno alongside Grok, positioning the bot as a multi-model orchestration layer.
